bullets.text: AI Evaluation Made Easy - **Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation** libraries help ensure AI applications produce reliable outcomes through structured evaluations.
Text Input for Copilot - **Copilot** on Windows now supports text input, enhancing user interaction and accessibility.
Empowering AI Ambitions - **Microsoft** partners with customers to leverage AI for transformative business solutions and societal impact.
Strengthening OpenAI Partnership - **Microsoft** and **OpenAI** deepen their collaboration with a new agreement enhancing AI innovation.
Cloud-to-Cloud Migration Simplified - **Azure Storage Mover** now supports direct transfers from AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage.
AI-Powered Browsing Experience - **Copilot Mode** in **Edge** transforms web browsing into an interactive, intelligent experience.
Enhanced Identity Security - **Microsoft** reimagines identity defense to address modern cyberthreats and protect user identities.
